cues.en: So a lot of students enroll in this course not really knowing what a recommender system is, and sometimes they have the wrong expectations about what we're gonna cover here.
cues.zh: 很多學生報名這門課時，其實不清楚什麼是推薦系統，有時對我們會介紹的內容抱持錯誤期待。

cues.en: So let's talk about what exactly is a recommender system?
cues.zh: 因此，來談談推薦系統究竟是什麼。

cues.en: And before we do that I think we need to start by talking about what a recommender system is not so a recommender system is not a system that just recommends arbitrary values for some arbitrary problem.
cues.zh: 在那之前，我想先說明推薦系統不是什麼。推薦系統並不是針對任意問題，隨便推薦某個數值的系統。

cues.en: That's not what it's all about.
cues.zh: 它講的不是這件事。

cues.en: So don't read too much into the name of it.
cues.zh: 所以不要對名稱做過度延伸的解讀。

cues.en: A recommender system is a very specific kind of machine learning system.
cues.zh: 推薦系統是一種非常特定的機器學習系統。

cues.en: But systems that just recommend values for arbitrary problems that describes machine learning in general that's not really a recommender system per say so the terminology can be a little bit confusing there.
cues.zh: 針對任意問題推薦數值的系統，描述的是一般的機器學習，本身不等於推薦系統，所以這裡的用語可能有點容易混淆。

cues.en: For example if you're looking for a system that quote unquote recommends prices for a house based on how big it is and the neighbors and all that.
cues.zh: 例如，你想找一個根據房屋大小、鄰近環境等等，「推薦」房價的系統。

cues.en: That's not a recommender system that's a machine learning system.
cues.zh: 那不是推薦系統，而是機器學習系統。

cues.en: If you want system that quote unquote recommends whether a transaction is fraudulent again that's not a recommender system.
cues.zh: 如果想要一個「推薦」某筆交易是否涉及詐欺的系統，同樣也不是推薦系統。

cues.en: That's to say machine learning problem more generally and for problems like that you're gonna be applying techniques like regression or deep learning or these days extra boost is really popular and there's
cues.zh: 那是比較一般的機器學習問題，這類問題可以使用迴歸、深度學習，或是近來很熱門的 XGBoost 等技術，還有

cues.en: many other techniques as well.
cues.zh: 許多其他技術可用。

cues.en: But recommender systems are a very specific thing.
cues.zh: 但推薦系統指的是很特定的東西。

cues.en: They're not this general purpose algorithm that can recommend a solution to any given problem.
cues.zh: 它不是能針對任何問題推薦解決方案的通用演算法。

cues.en: You can't think of it that broadly.
cues.zh: 不能把它想得那麼廣泛。

cues.en: If you're looking for something like that you're gonna want to go and take a more general machine learning course.
cues.zh: 如果你在找的是那類內容，應該去上一門較通用的機器學習課程。

cues.en: This one is very specialized for what we call recommender systems.
cues.zh: 這門課專門討論我們所稱的推薦系統。

cues.en: So what is a recommender system.
cues.zh: 那麼，什麼是推薦系統？

cues.en: Well more specifically it's a system that predicts ratings or preferences that a user might give to an item.
cues.zh: 更具體地說，它會預測使用者可能給某個項目的評分或偏好。

cues.en: So a recommender system is recommending things to people based on their past behavior and the behavior of other people.
cues.zh: 因此，推薦系統根據使用者過去的行為，以及其他人的行為，向他推薦東西。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So it's really about recommending stuff to people based on their their pregnancies that we learn over time.
cues.zh: 重點是隨時間了解使用者的偏好，據此推薦東西給他們。

cues.en: Now often these will be sorted and presented as what we call top end recommendations.
cues.zh: 這些推薦通常會排序，以所謂的 Top-N 推薦呈現。

cues.en: So we're not necessarily recommending a specific rating or preference for an item we might just be recommending a list of items that somebody might like.
cues.zh: 我們不一定要預測使用者對某個項目的具體評分或偏好，也可能只是推薦一份他可能喜歡的項目清單。

cues.en: These are also known as recommender engines recommendation systems and recommendation platforms it's all the same thing.
cues.zh: 它也叫做推薦引擎、推薦系統或推薦平台，指的都是同一件事。

cues.en: So to make it real this is what a recommender engine in the sense of this course looks like.
cues.zh: 舉個實際例子，本課程所說的推薦引擎就是這種樣子。

cues.en: If you go to amazon.com you'll see a bunch of widgets like this where they're recommending products based on other things that you've looked at in the past or interacted with and also blending in information
cues.zh: 前往 amazon.com，會看到許多這類小工具，根據你過去瀏覽或互動過的其他東西推薦商品，同時也整合

cues.en: from all the other customers at Amazon.com as well.
cues.zh: Amazon.com 其他所有顧客的資訊。

cues.en: So a recommender system is trying to recommend stuff to you.
cues.zh: 因此，推薦系統是試著推薦東西給你。

cues.en: It doesn't have to necessarily be physical objects.
cues.zh: 不一定要是實體物品。

cues.en: It could also be content it could be music.
cues.zh: 也可以是內容、音樂，

cues.en: It could be videos right.
cues.zh: 或影片，對吧？

cues.en: So if you go to Netflix they're recommending movies to you based on your past preferences and the preferences of other people.
cues.zh: 例如 Netflix 會根據你過去的喜好，以及其他人的喜好，推薦電影。

cues.en: You can recommend people in a dating application you can recommend music in a music playing application.
cues.zh: 交友應用程式可以推薦對象，音樂播放應用程式可以推薦音樂。

cues.en: So let's dive more to what's the more specific types of recommender systems are out there.
cues.zh: 接著深入看看推薦系統還有哪些更具體的種類。

cues.en: Now we sort of cleared up what they are not.
cues.zh: 現在我們大致釐清了它不是什麼。
